(e) All side emergency exits shall be permanently fixed in the closed position. The corresponding side emergency exit on an adjacent car shall also be fixed in the closed position. The installation shall comply with Section 2.12.6.

Delete and revise Subsection (b) of Section 8.7.2.14.3 to read as follows:
previewText: (e) All side emergency exits shall be permanently fixed in the closed position.
